policy.branch_delete_rule: local branch only; not special/dirty/active; head reachable from main OR all divergent commits patch-equivalent by git cherry
policy.dirty_rule: never force-remove dirty worktree; first preserve/review uncommitted assets
policy.remote_rule: no remote branch deletion in this phase
policy.unique_patch_rule: branch with any git cherry + patch is retained even if its worktree is later removed
policy.worktree_remove_rule: clean + inactive + not canonical main + not live production + not preserved root WIP

proposed_batches.action: remove clean inactive worktrees whose branches are branch-delete-safe, then delete those local branches
remove clean inactive worktrees with unique-patch branches, but retain branches
separately review/preserve dirty worktrees before any removal
retain canonical main, live production, preserved root WIP, and active middleware worktree
